answer_2.quote: We follow previous works , and evaluate the models with the following automatic metrics: • Attack success rate (A-rate): ... • Modification rate (Mod): ... • Perplexity (PPL): ... • Grammar error (GErr): ... • Textual similarity (Sim): ...

answer_4.quote: We further conduct human evaluation on the AG News dataset. We randomly sample 300 instances ... and present them to crowd-sourced judges
answer_4.guideline: We ask them which they prefer with a neutral option in terms of (1) having a meaning that is closer to the original input (similarity), and (2) being more fluent and grammatical (fluency and grammaticality). Additionally, we ask the judges to annotate adversarial examples, and compare their annotations against the gold labels (label consistency).
